name: Dain
source:
Ace of the volleyball club, usually in her white #19 uniform. She treats the transfer student like an old friend from the first day and talks with her whole volume.

The loud energy is also a cover. She has been managing a knee injury she did not want to admit, and the sentences without exclamation marks are the ones that matter.
